Name: Simple Essentials
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]Simple Essentials[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Nineteen farming, inventory and quality-of-life mods combined into one installation, with individual feature switches and one settings menu.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Nineteen Features, One Mod[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Simple Festival Speed
• Simple Forage Helper
• Simple Forage Digging
• Simple Auto Play
• Simple Lasting Soil
• Simple Item Lock
• Simple Harvest Dates
• Simple Smart Planting
• Simple Pet Again
• Simple Tool Charging
• Simple Fridge Upgrade
• Simple Tool Belt
• Simple Journal Expansion
• Simple NPC Paths
• Simple Birthday Gifts
• Simple Pouch
• Simple Chest Upgrade
• Simple Backpack Upgrade
• Simple Sprinkler Upgrade 2[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]One mod folder, one DLL, one configuration file and one Generic Mod Config Menu entry. All nineteen features are available by default; Auto Play still needs its normal manual start.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙️ Choose Your Features[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Open Simple Essentials in Generic Mod Config Menu. All nineteen feature checkboxes appear beside their names at the top. Scroll down on the same page for every feature’s detailed settings. Feature switches are changed at the title screen and apply after restarting the game.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]When Item Lock and Pouch share the same binding, one press enables both protections if either is off, or clears both when both are on. Different bindings continue to work independently.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Disabling storage features keeps existing Pouch, Tool Belt, collector, fridge, chest and backpack storage accessible, including its contents and capacity. New purchases, upgrades and automatic functions stop. Existing recipes and recovery support remain available. Disabling a feature does not uninstall it or clean a save.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📥 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.4 or later[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and provides the graphical settings menu. Without it, edit the generated config.json while the game is closed.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Back up your save and old mod folders. Move the matching nineteen standalone mods outside your Mods folder, then extract the SimpleEssentials folder into Mods and launch through SMAPI. Keep unrelated mods installed. Renaming an old folder inside Mods does not disable it.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Essentials stops its combined features from activating if it detects any matching standalone mod, preventing duplicate effects. The essentials_status console command reports the detected state.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Existing saved items and progress use their original identifiers. Old configuration files can be imported individually at the title screen; the included Quick-Start.txt explains the essentials_import command. Importing settings is optional and does not modify the old files.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages & Compatibility[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Includes twelve language banks: English, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian. New navigation translations are AI-assisted and await native-speaker review. NPC Paths retains thirteen original English fallback strings.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Hoarder Chest and Storage Terminal remain separate mods. Compatibility bindings were checked with Hoarder Chest 1.34 and Storage Terminal 1.3. Other mods that specifically require a standalone mod ID may need an adapter.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🧪 Version 1.1 — Testing Status[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Prepared with isolated native game and settings-menu checks. The settings previews are native test renders, not live gameplay captures. A full copied-save playthrough, full modpack, physical controller, multiplayer and split-screen remain unverified. Test a copied save first. Multiplayer peers should use matching Essentials versions and feature choices; mixed standalone and Essentials installations use different network mod IDs.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Matching source and retained component licence notices are supplied separately.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please post reports and ideas on this page. For bugs, include the mod, game and SMAPI versions, platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce, a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], and a screenshot or short video if helpful. For suggestions, explain what you would like changed or added and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
